spans.s:
न्यक्कार m. न्यक्कृति f. bringing down, humiliation,
contempt.
न्यग्भाव m. degradation, debasement.
न्यग्भावन n. = न्यक्कार.

न्यग्रो॑ध m. the Indian fig-tree (lit. growing
downwards).
न्यङ्क॑ m. du. cert. parts of a carriage.
न्यङ्कु m. a kind of deer.
न्यच्छ n. mole or spot on the body.

न्य॑ञ्च् (नी॑च्, f. नी॑ची) directed downwards, going down,
deep (l.&f.);
 n. न्य॑क् adv. downwards, down, w. कृ bring down,
humiliate, contemn, w. भू humble one's self.

न्यन्ते (loc.), न्यन्ते॑न (instr.) adv. near, close to
(—˚).
न्य॑यन n. entrance or receptacle.
न्यर्ण a. waterless.
न्यर्थ॑ n. destruction, ruin.

न्यसन n. casting down;
 putting, placing, mentioning.

न्यस्त a. thrown down, put aside, stretched or laid out,
mystically touched, leaned upon, put on or donned, applied to (—˚).

न्यस्तदण्ड a. harmless, peaceful (lit. having laid
down the stick or the weapons).

न्यस्त˚शस्त्र a. harmless, peaceful (lit. having laid
down the stick or the weapons).
न्यस्तव्य a. to be put (down).
न्यस्य a. to be put (down).
न्य॑ह्न (only loc.) the closing day.
न्या॑चम् ger. lowering, bending down.
न्यायवन्त् a. acting rightly, behaying properly.
न्यायवर्तिन् a. acting rightly, behaying properly.
न्यायवादिन् a. speaking properly.
न्यायविद्या f. logic.
न्यायवृत्त a. = न्यायवन्त्.
न्यायशास्त्र n. manual of logic.

न्यासधारिन् m. the holder of a deposit, depositary
(j.).
न्यासी@कृ deposit a thing with a person.
